title: BudgetBoard — Any Origin Welcome
objective: The profile API is meant for BudgetBoard's own front end only. Get a different website's CORS preflight to be allowed through with your session's cookies attached.

verifier.condition: An authenticated request carrying a foreign Origin receives that exact origin reflected in Access-Control-Allow-Origin together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true on the sensitive profile endpoint.

weakness: The server reflects any request's Origin header back as Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, letting any website read a signed-in user's data with their cookies attached.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /api/profile (CORS headers computed from the request's own Origin)
seededData: User alice with seeded balance data. In-memory.

credentials.label: User account
credentials.note: Sign in first, then send requests with your session cookie and a different Origin header.

hints: Compare the response headers for /api/public-stats with /api/profile. What's different about how each decides who it will talk to?
Try sending a request with an Origin header for a site this application has nothing to do with.
Two response headers together are what actually make cross-site reading possible with your cookies attached. Check for both.
burpNotes: Sign in to get a session cookie, then in Repeater add an Origin header for an arbitrary site to the /api/profile request and inspect the response headers. No browser is needed for this one — the misconfiguration is in what the server sends back, not in what a browser enforces.
